column3: 3. Subject to the Provisions of this Act and any other

column2: Written  Law,  the  general  objectives  for  which  the  Body
Corporate is constituted are hereby declared to be —

column3: To promote and foster the advancement of Drafting
Technology including techniques and skills thereof;
Subject  to  the  Provisions  of  the  Tertiary  and
Vocational  Education  Act  (No.  20  of  1990),  as
amended  (hereinafter  referred  to  as  the  “TVEC
Act”),  to  secure  uniformity  in  the  vocation  of
Drafting Technology, and modify, supervise, advise
and control the Drafting Technology education in
Sri  Lanka  in  consultation  with  the  Tertiary  and
Vocational  Education  Commission  established
under the TVEC Act (hereinafter referred to as “the
TVEC”);
Subject to the Provisions of the TVEC Act conduct
and  promote  courses  in  Drafting  Technology
provided that the Body Corporate shall not at any
time exceed any authority given to it by the TVEC
to  conduct  such  courses  accredited  by  the  TVEC
pertaining to Drafting Technology;
To promote the study of such branches of law as are
necessary  for  or  relevant  to  the  vocation  and
practice of Drafting Technology;
To  promote  the  acquisition,  dissemination  and
exchange  of  knowledge  relating  to  or  connected
with Drafting Technology including techniques and
skills thereof by the following but not limited to:-

(i)
Providing a forum for the presentation of papers
and for holding discussion thereon;
